ResourceHeader.Description:
This collection contains all PUNCH Level 3 science image products derived from observations by the Narrow Field Imager (NFI) and the three Wide Field Imagers (WFI-1, WFI-2, and WFI-3). The currently distributed products include clear and polarized low-noise mosaics, instrument-specific clear and polarized F-corona models, clear and polarized starfield models, and final clear and polarized K-corona science mosaics.

The collection also retains SPASE records for deprecated Level 3 products that are no longer distributed through the Solar Data Analysis Center (SDAC), in order to preserve their metadata and processing-history context.

Per instructions from the PUNCH team, reference to the entire Collection, including the DOI below, should be used when PUNCH Level 3 products are cited:

Southwest Research Institute (2025). PUNCH NFI-WFI Level-3 Science images [Collection]. Solar Data Analysis Center. https://doi.org/10.48322/nnv7-bn21. Access date (assigned on date of landing page access).
